title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch â€” deferred schema loader
description: The Claude Code ToolSearch tool was used multiple times during fix_signal to load deferred moeb MCP tool schemas before calling them. No moeb-registered tool covers schema pre-loading in MCP mode. This is a structural gap in the MCP session initialization path.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to expose all tool schemas eagerly in the MCP initialize handshake so agents never need ToolSearch during a run, or introduce a moeb preload_schemas tool that performs this operation within the moeb registry.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
